"Explore sample outputs and ready-to-use PDF scenarios"

Keep the four document illustrations readable and recognizable at 800px width. Do not add a new headline, unrelated branding, extra UI, new cards, watermarks, or new objects. No cropping of any card or category badge. Do not change the logos inside the individual document examples in this edit.
Maintain the original 1672x941 canvas and aspect ratio if possible, opaque background, polished production-ready raster artwork. Treat this as a targeted branding correction, not a redesign.
